import collections,hashlib,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(sys.argv[1]); expected=sys.argv[2]
raw=p.read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==expected
events=json.loads(raw)['traceEvents']; del raw
kernels=collections.Counter(e['name'] for e in events if e.get('cat')=='kernel');cpu=collections.Counter(e['name'] for e in events if e.get('cat')=='cpu_op')
needles=['kda','delta','chunk','fla','causal','triton']
result=dict(trace_sha256=expected,kernel_names=len(kernels),matched_kernels={n:c for n,c in kernels.items() if any(x in n.lower() for x in needles)},matched_cpu_ops={n:c for n,c in cpu.items() if any(x in n.lower() for x in needles) or any(x in n for x in ['ExpBackward','MaskedFillBackward','CumsumBackward'])},scope='Full-name inventory is dispatch evidence only; it does not identify numerical values or prove the cause of nonfinite gradients.')
Path(sys.argv[3]).write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(result))
